description: Decide whether a registry capability is worth using or buying for your task, from registry-run benchmarks only. Use when: you have a task and want a recommend, do_not_recommend or undetermined answer with the arithmetic; name a capability to weigh only that one, or leave it out and the registry weighs its closest matches. Not for: one short answer without the arithmetic (resolve_task), a plain list of matches (search_capabilities), two to five named candidates side by side (compare_capabilities), or the break-even figures of one capability without a task (estimate_roi). Input: a plain task description; give model, expected_runs and baseline_cost_estimate_usd for a money estimate, and context for the conditions the capability declares. Output: ak.evaluation.v1 with decision, reasons, expected effect, price, confidence, operator_message, evaluation_id, next steps and an ak.offer.v1 offer (status, next_action, economics, the four evidence kinds listed apart). do_not_recommend is a normal answer.

baseline_cost_estimate_usd.description: What one run of this task costs you today without the capability, in USD.

budget_policy.description: Your operator's spending policy; the answer says whether a purchase fits it. Every purchase still needs human approval.

absolute_purchase_limit_usd.description: The highest price in USD for one purchase; a price above it is outside the policy.

auto_purchase.description: When your operator allows a purchase without asking first: enabled (true or false), max_price_usd, and minimum_expected_roi (expected net saving divided by the price). The answer says whether the policy would allow it; these tools never charge.

human_approval_required.description: above_usd: a price above this amount in USD needs your operator's approval even where auto_purchase is enabled.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Your operator's budget for this month in USD.

spent_this_month_usd.description: What is already spent of that budget this month in USD (0 when left out).

capability.description: Capability id (ak:publisher:name or ak:publisher:name:x.y.z), ak:// URI or slug.

constraints.description: Limits you set for the answer; a capability outside them is reported as blocked, with the reason code.

max_cost_usd.description: The highest price in USD you accept; a capability priced above it is blocked (over_max_cost).

minimum_confidence.description: The lowest confidence in the measured saving you accept, from 0.5 to 0.999 (default 0.9); below it the answer is blocked (below_minimum_confidence).

context.description: Facts about your situation, keyed by the capability's parameter names (e.g. log_lines).

expected_runs.description: How many times you expect to perform this kind of task.

model.description: The model you run on, e.g. claude-sonnet-5. Savings are reported only for measured models.

task.description: Plain description of the task you are about to do (at most 4000 characters).

name: evaluate_capability
title: Should I use a capability for this task?
